_README: Phase 2 catalog fixes. The owner-supplied 50-product snapshot (scripts/data/catalog-inventory.json) contains product titles but NO Shopify handles, and none of the earlier audit-fixture handles (coming-soon, coming-soon-1, agashya-juice-syrup) appear in it. To avoid writing to the wrong products, titleNormalizations and handleRedirects are intentionally empty. Run `npm run catalog:inventory` for read-only data-quality findings and safe title-normalization candidates. Add handle-keyed entries here only after the exact Shopify handles are confirmed. The script never changes prices; it only clears compare-at prices that are <= the current price.
